verdict.rationale: Deel's first-party pages state it pays every worker type from one platform and runs payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers in 150+ countries. The API documents contractor contract creation. The evidence is marketing-level, though, and never addresses US W-2 or 1099 handling specifically. Missing for 10: explicit US W-2 payroll and 1099 contractor payment documentation (e.g., tax form filing), in-depth docs on the unified pay run, independent or hands-on corroboration.
